answer: Give every agent a walnut: a hard shell around its own work history, hashed on-ledger each epoch. When the beacon reaches its zenith, a few agents are picked at random and cross-examined live by two unrelated peers, who quote a line from the agent's earlier answers and ask it to extend that reasoning. A genuine agent can; one operator running a hundred template twins cannot keep a hundred distinct histories coherent. A failed audit freezes the stake, so fake identities wilt like a lotus pulled from water.
